name: YJ MGC 4x4
reviews: Cảm giác hơi 'rẻ' nhưng nhanh, ổn định, cắt góc tốt
description: The YJ MGC 4x4 Magnetic Cube is the first 4x4 in the MGC line and is perfect for speedcubers who love fast turning. This magnetic cube features incredibly smooth turning, widened outer edge pieces for added stability, and a flexible mechanism with a loose feel out of the box. If you're looking for one of the best magnetic cubes for speed and performance, the MGC 4x4 is a top choice!
